scripts.validate:links: npm run crawl && npm run validate:nav
scripts.validate:nav: npx tsx -e "import { validateNavigation } from './src/config/nav.js'; const result = validateNavigation(); console.log(result); process.exit(result.valid ? 0 : 1);"
scripts.ci:links: npm run crawl && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:smoke
scripts.report:links: npx tsx -e "console.log('\nLink Validation Report:\nSee artifacts/ directory for detailed CSV reports and go-live-report.md')"
